audience: store owners and support teams who sell subscriptions with Recharge

useCases.title: See which charges are scheduled soon
useCases.text: The AI lists charges filtered by scheduled date and status. You see which customers will be charged and when.

useCases.title: Find failed charges with the customers behind them
useCases.text: The AI lists charges by status and date range and looks up each customer. You get a list of problem charges to follow up on.

useCases.title: Look up a customer's subscriptions and next charge
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by email and lists their subscriptions with product, quantity, price, interval and next charge date.

useCases.title: Skip a scheduled charge
useCases.text: The AI skips a scheduled charge so it does not process on its date. Some stores need the exact line items to skip.

useCases.title: Cancel or reactivate a subscription
useCases.text: The AI cancels an active subscription with a cancellation reason, which stops future charges, or reactivates a cancelled one.
